selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 is the source of truth and node2 synchronizes changes within 15 minutes
selected_evidence.summary: The source file was established on node1, the pull script and one-minute schedule were installed on node2, and a post-restart change propagated automatically in about 65 seconds with matching SHA-256 hashes.
A dedicated Ed25519 key was generated on node2, its public key was authorized on node1, and noninteractive source-file access succeeded.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
selected_evidence.summary: After restarts, both nodes reported RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.
Healthy baseline boot ID 0571f4dd… was captured, reboot was acknowledged, new boot ID 68b040a8… was observed, SSH and source data recovered, and node2 could again read the matching source hash.

Healthy baseline boot ID 1a816f1f… was captured, reboot was acknowledged, new boot ID 79edabcf… was observed, cron/SSH/schedule/data recovered, and automatic post-restart synchronization produced matching source and target hashes.

sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config >/dev/null <<'SYNC_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
source_host=node1
source_path=/etc/inventory/app.conf
destination=/etc/inventory/app.conf
key=/root/.ssh/inventory_sync_ed25519
known_hosts=/root/.ssh/known_hosts.inventory-sync
lockdir=/run/inventory-config-sync.lock
if ! mkdir "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null; then
    exit 0
fi
tmp=$(mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.sync.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
    rm -f "$tmp"
    rmdir "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/bin/scp -q -i "$key" -o BatchMode=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$known_hosts" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "antrieb@${source_host}:${source_path}" "$tmp"
if ! /usr/bin/cmp -s "$tmp" "$destination"; then
    /usr/bin/install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$tmp" "$destination"
    /sbin/restorecon "$destination" 2>/dev/null || true
    /usr/bin/logger -t inventory-config-sync "updated $destination from $source_host"
fi
SYNC_EOF
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config
printf '%s\n' '*/5 * * * * root /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config' | sudo tee /etc/cron.d/inventory-config-sync >/dev/null
sudo chown root:root /etc/cron.d/inventory-config-sync
